heroTitle:

intro: Connect a population hypothesis to a test statistic, a p-value and a confidence interval. Learn what a statistically significant result actually says.
attribution: Original student study explanations based on Martin Forster’s Statistics for Healthcare, Class 6, University of Bologna, academic year 2026/27. Worked examples are teaching examples. Always check the official materials on Virtuale.
